integrity: The claim is proved by a complete finite-group Fourier diagonalization and an elementary one-variable optimization. Finite numerical checks were used only for sanity checking and not as proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real scalar targets, exponent 2, and even torus half-side m. It does not compute Banach-valued or non-Hilbertian exact constants, and an equivalent older Fourier/Poincare formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact scalar \(L_2\) metric-cotype lifting constant on even discrete tori
